Let Rupesh purchase 100 kg of raw material at Rs. 1 per kg.

Total C.P = 100 * 1 = Rs. 100

C.P of used raw material = 100 * 72.5/100 = Rs. 72.5

Manufacturing cost = 100 + (72.5 * 60/100) = Rs. 143.5

S.P = 143.5 * 140/100 = Rs. 200.9

M.P = 200.9 * 100/80 = Rs. 251.125

Hence, the required value = 251.125/100 = 2.511
